mentions.name: Aurora Glass
mentions.description: A macOS menu bar app that displays a living animated aurora across the menu bar. It also doubles as a status light for coding agents. It is free and requires no account or permissions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Aurora Glass, a living aurora animated across your Mac's menu bar.

It doubles as a status light for coding agents. But mostly I just like looking at it.

Free, no account, no permissions: https://aurora.radiantmachines.com
mentions.author: gourneau
